name: Nyuuin Kansha Ayanami Rei Iryou Karte
original_name: 入院姦者 綾×レイ医凌カルテ
source:
Train a girl like a human guinea pig with the perfect sexual disposition by controlling every parameter of the experiment.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE033294.html]DLSite English[/url]]
